summary: Frontend-only verification for the native-iOS Feed redesign + in-app plan links. Executed at 390x844 (mobile) and desktop against the public preview URL. All five requested scenarios pass end-to-end: (1) MyOpenPlans and EventOpenPlans use relative <Link to='/plan/<slug>'> (data-testid my-plan-<slug> / event-plan-<slug>); grep of frontend/src confirms NO ${API}/p/ or /api/p/ hrefs remain; clicking a my-plan card performs SPA navigation (verified by survival of window.__noreload__ sentinel). (2) In-app push notification tap on a plan_invite row navigates to /plan/<slug> (verified by clicking a plan notification while logged in as amigo@quienva.app). (3) Feed as test@quienva.app in Madrid (no events tonight) shows compact 'feed-my-plans', the 'tonight-block-today' header is visible within the first 844px viewport (y=543), 'feed-moving-now' section is removed, 'tonight-empty-compact' shows exactly 'Esta noche no hay nada confirmado en Madrid.' with 'Lo que viene ↓' and 'Monta tú el plan' CTAs; no 'tonight-empty-upcoming-row'; see-upcoming scrolls to #sec-upcoming (scrollY=713); create-plan opens the in-app CreatePlanSheet drawer; nothing links outside the app. (4) Guest feed with qv_guest_city='Ibiza' at 390px: 16 EventCards render, 6+ MovingBadges visible including the required moving-badge-7b301580-11f6-462b-b355-4178d8b28250, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 391 vs innerWidth 390); compact mode (feed-compact-toggle) also renders the small badge on CompactEventCard (31 badges after scroll). (5) Regression: CreatePlanSheet drawer still opens from the empty-state CTA; no console errors from lib/liveActivity on web (startPlanActivity is a no-op). Code review: toInternalPath in NativeDeepLinks.js correctly maps quienva://plan/abc -> /plan/abc, https://x/api/p/abc -> /plan/abc, /event/1 -> /event/1 (regex /^\/p\/(?!nuevo)([^/?#]+)/ -> /plan/$1 and /^\/api(?=\/p\/)/ strip for https URLs). No 'feed-moving-now' references remain; MovingNow exports MovingBadge and isMoving as expected. Overall redesign spec is correctly implemented.

verifications.tonight_empty_compact_text: Esta noche no hay nada confirmado en Madrid.

critical_code_review_comments: MovingNow.MIN_MOVEMENT = 4 may hide the badge on brand-new events with only 1 RSVP; current threshold matches spec intent ('nunca inventamos números').
Feed.js tonight-empty-compact uses cityLabel.split(',')[0]; if cityLabel is empty/undefined this becomes '' and the sentence reads 'en .' Guard with cityLabel ? ... : 'tu zona' for robustness.

EventOpenPlans.js header text 'Planes abiertos para esta fiesta' is hardcoded Spanish (not i18n'd). Same for Feed empty-state copy. OK if intentional per 'UI text in feed empty state is Spanish hardcoded', but EventOpenPlans is a separate screen (EventDetail) and should likely use useTranslation for consistency.
NativeDeepLinks.toInternalPath handles quienva:// and https://.../api/p/<slug> correctly; consider also stripping a trailing fragment from quienva:// deeplinks (currently preserved via custom[1]).
test_credentials: test@quienva.app / Test1234! and amigo@quienva.app / Test1234! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Login via page.request.post to avoid preview 403 on urllib.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing TEST invite-reg plan already in DB for notification-click assertion; attempted a fresh POST /api/plans returned 400 (payload shape) but was not required because an existing plan_invite notification was available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All redesign assertions pass. For a cleaner notification test, main agent could POST /api/plans with the correct schema (likely 'invitees' or 'participantes' instead of 'invitar_user_ids') — current call returned 400. The badge target event id 7b301580 is reliably buzzing in the Ibiza guest feed (6+ badges). To test mobile viewport, remember to await page.set_viewport_size({width:390,height:844}) BEFORE page.goto, otherwise the preview falls back to desktop (1920 wide).
